concerns.text: FR-002 states 'scaffold-based split with fixed ratios [deferred] train, [deferred] validation, [deferred] test' while FR-013 states the system 'does not alter the 80/10/10 split ratios'. The two FRs are mutually incompatible: FR-002 leaves the ratios undefined while FR-013 hard-codes 80/10/10. Restore the explicit 80/10/10 ratios in FR-002 (also mandated by Constitution Principle VI) so both FRs agree.
FR IDs jump from FR-013 to FR-015 with no FR-014. If FR-014 was removed during revision, renumber or note the gap; as-is, cross-reference consumers may treat the missing ID as a dangling reference.
